# E.C.S. Electronics produces 1500 different electronic models, which cover the range of more than 5000 models of cars.

We mainly export our products to the EU MARKET.

Our production complies with EU DIRECTIVES RoHS 2002/95/EC and 2004/104/EC.

All the production stages, from the project to manufacturing of test benches, from prototypes to series production, are performed in-house by expert personnel.

The main production activities are organized on particular workplaces:

<strong>1) Wire and Crimp department</strong>: producing cables components using Komax machinery.
